lines.speaker: Super Buu
lines.text: Now listen to them, child — the voices of those you failed to save.

lines.speaker: Super Buu
lines.text: Go on — I can see what he sees, I can feel what he feels!

lines.speaker: Goten
lines.text: What's going on? Was I an egg? Where am I?

lines.speaker: DoorDash Driver
lines.text: Uh, DoorDash for a Mr. Buu?

lines.speaker: DoorDash Driver
lines.text: No, no, no, wait, wait, wait!
